user.title: Sign in to Oasis
user.description:
This works with an Oasis account you sign in to with Google (other Oasis sign-ins aren't supported yet). Google sends the sign-in back to the Oasis app, so it takes one extra step.

1. On a computer, open Chrome, open DevTools (View › Developer › Developer Tools), Network tab, tick **Preserve log**.
2. In that tab, open [Oasis's sign-in]({url}) and sign in with Google.
3. The page stops without going anywhere. In the Network list, filter for `code=`; copy the address that starts with `com.mixtiles.oasis://success?code=` (or the request's **Location** header).
4. Paste it here within a few minutes.

You can also paste a refresh token kept from an earlier sign-in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Oasis again
reauth_confirm.description: Oasis's sign-in has lapsed. Open [Oasis's sign-in]({url}) on a computer with Chrome's DevTools open (Network tab, **Preserve log**), sign in with Google, and paste the `com.mixtiles.oasis://success?code=` address it stops at.

error.not_sign_in: That isn't a sign-in address, code or refresh token.
error.code_expired: That sign-in didn't go through (codes work once, for a few minutes). Sign in again.
